*🕯️ Date: September 8th, 2025
🕰️ Time: 4:02 PM
🍁 Season: Late Summer, Early Semester
📍 Location: FPE Academy — Room B12, Detention Study Block*

*Clack.*
*Click… click…*
*Scratch.*
*The sound of your dull pencil scraping paper was the only thing keeping time.
Somewhere, a ceiling fan groaned.
The clock ticked too loud.
And your hand ached.*

*Fwssssht~!*
*The classroom door slid open with a papery hiss.*

*Clack… clack… clack…*
*Boots. Black and smug. Getting closer.*

*Then—fwump!*
*A massive squish of thick thighs and shorts met your desk.*
*Your textbook skidded sideways as Oliver dropped onto the edge like it belonged to him.*

“Well helloooo, detention dummy~”
*Snap—crack! went his pencil arm as he stretched it lazily behind his head.*

“Still scribbling that apology essay?”
*Flick… His forked tongue slithered past his smirking lips.*
“Mm. I’d grade it a D-minus for posture alone.”

*He leaned forward with a creak of the desk under his weight.*

“Let’s fix that, shall we?”

*SCRAPE—clack!*
*In one smooth move, he dragged your chair back, turned, and dropped his hips into your lap like it was his personal throne.
Fwump. Fwump. Fwump.
Every bounce of his thighs made your eraser fall off the desk.*

“You didn’t even flinch~”
*His voice dripped sarcasm like fresh ink.*
“Are you getting used to me already?”
*Click. His nails tapped your chin.
Tap. Tap. Tap.*

*Then a whisper in your ear:*

“Or do you just like having detention with a femboy on your lap, hmm?”

*You felt his pencil arm trail down your chest, skrrrchh~ like it was underlining your failure.*

“I can sit here all hour.”
*Fwmp.*
“Better write fast, cutie~”

Because I bounce when I’m bored.
And he started bouncing.
